Net Asset Value update – Q3 2026 | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings UK Newswire New Login Register Net Asset Value update – Q3 2026 Summary by AI BETA Close X TRIG reports an unchanged Q3 NAV of 101.1p per share at 30 September 2026, driven by +0.4p from portfolio outperformance and +2.0p from revised revenue forecasts offset by -2.4p from a 0.3% rise in blended discount rates to 9.4% (from 9.1%). The Board reaffirmed the FY2026 dividend target of 7.55p (yield 9.4% at an 80.4p share price). Liquidity: gross cash cover c.2.1x pre c.£190m project-level debt repayment and net dividend cover c.1.1x post-repayment. Capital actions: 38.1m shares repurchased for £29.2m and a £157m Beatrice divestment reduced RCF borrowings to £184m; near-term power forwards could add c.1–2p/share.
